title: AI and ML Tooling
content: Kevin's AI and ML work is tied to practical interfaces and developer tools rather than isolated demos. The portfolio includes a Gemini-backed portfolio assistant, an expressive robot head using Whisper, llama.cpp, Zonos, Silero VAD, PyTorch, CUDA, ROS2, and OpenCV, plus AI coding-agent tools such as bento-ya, choomfie, clanker-spanker, and component-cop. His current role at Hamming AI is Software Engineer at a YC S24 startup building AI-powered developer tools.
